launched an underwritten public offering of 8.5M Class A shares by a selling stockholder on Wednesday.
The underwriters have a 30-day option to purchase up to 1.28M additional shares.
The company will not receive proceeds from the 8.5M shares sold by the selling stockholder.
However, it will receive proceeds only if the additional 1.28M option shares are sold.
The offering remains subject to market conditions, and its final size and terms have not been determined.
